senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be dark, hot, cmp. חמץ,]

units: <cite ref="Temurah 16a:27-41">Tem. 16ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="P00747"><he>עַכְסָה</he></cite>) <he>כל … כּוֹעֵס על וכ׳</he> whoever saw her became displeased with his own wife.
<cite ref="Nedarim 22a:9">Ned. 22ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל הכועס</he> whoever allows himself to be carried away by his wrath.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45:2">Ex. R. s. 45</cite> <he>מטרונה שכָּעֲסָה על וכ׳</he> a matron (queen) that was angry with the king’s daughter; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K00963"><he>כָּעוּס</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="K00044"><he>כְּעוּסָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>כְּעוּסִים</he>, <he>כְּעוּסוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45:2">Ib.</cite> <he>כשיהיו פניך כ׳ וכ׳</he> when thou shalt be angry, I shall conciliate thee &c.; (Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 <he>כשאהיה אני בכעס</he>); a. e.—V. <cite ref="K00963"><he>כָּעוּס</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to grow hot in the stomach, to ferment, swell.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 70a:10">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>לכשתִּכְעוֹס תעמוד על מליאה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מילואך</he>) when it (the food) swells, it will just fill the capacity of thy stomach.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:17">Deut. R. s. 3</cite>. <he>שהם עתידים להַכְעִיס אותי</he> that they are going to provoke me (through idolatry).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:2">Ab. V, 2</cite> <he>היו מַכְעִיסִין וכ׳</he> were constantly provoking (the Lord).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27a">Snh. 27ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>להַכְעִיס</he> in a spirit of defiance, v. <cite ref="M00525"><he>מוּמָר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Imper. <he>אַכְעִיס</he> (for <cite ref="K00970"><he>הכעיס</he></cite>). Ruth R. end (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 4:5">Ps. IV, 5</cite>) <he>ארגיז יצרך … א׳ יצרך ולא תחטא</he> let thy tempter rage, but sin not; but the Rabbis say, arouse thy (good) inclination to indignation, and thou shalt not sin. [Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c. <he>אַכְחֵישׁ … ואל יחטיאך</he> weaken thy tempter (by ascetics) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 627">Yalk. Ps. 627</cite>;—Pesik. Shubah, p. 158ᵃ <he>אכופס</he>, corr. acc.]
